data.name: Trix
data.gender_notes: Trix is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In ancient Greek mythology, Trix was a goddess of tricks and mischief. In Christian tradition, the name Trix is associated with the Holy Trinity, representing the three persons in one God. The name Trix carries the meaning “Trickster or triune” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Trix usually hope their child will grow to embody trickster or triune and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace the playful and adaptable spirit of Trix.
data.etymology: Trix belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Trickster or triune.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Trix total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

Trix, as a name, serves as a gentle reminder of this fundamental belief, offering a subtle spiritual significance for those who bear the name. It's an inspiring and thoughtful choice, tying the individual to the deeper spiritual truths of their faith.
